title: Homogeneous pursuit in $\beta$ model
abstract: arXiv:2611.17609v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Data in forms of networks has been encountered in various prevalent fields at the arrival of big data era. To unveil and recover the true model with core units with numerous links, the $\beta$-model under sparsity constraint is proposed to meet the expectation of statisticians and engineers. Not only does this network model inherit spectacular property from the Erd\H{o}s-R\'enyi model, but also exhibits degree heterogeneity through tuning sparsity parameter $s$. In this paper, we propose Homogeneous Pursuit (HP), an $\ell_0$-constrained maximum likelihood estimation method implemented through a primal-dual algorithm. To ease the harshness of computation, we find the surrogate function of the corresponding objective function to derive Majorization Minimization algorithm through the primal-dual process. Moreover, after meticulous evaluation, the algorithm brought about captures the property of fine convergence rate in a contraction mappi

translated_abstract: 随着大数据时代的到来，以网络形式呈现的数据已出现在众多重要领域之中。为了揭示并恢复拥有大量连接的核心单元的真实模型，带有稀疏性约束的β模型被提出，以满足统计学家和工程师的需求。该网络模型不仅继承了Erdős-Rényi模型的优异性质，还通过调节稀疏性参数 $s$ 展现出度异质性。在本文中，我们提出了同质追踪方法，这是一种通过原始-对偶算法实现的 $\ell_0$ 约束最大似然估计方法。为了减轻繁重的计算负担，我们找到了相应目标函数的替代函数，从而在原始-对偶过程中推导出主化-最小化算法。此外，经过细致的评估，我们所提出的算法在收缩映射的意义下具有良好的收敛速度特性。
tldr: 本文提出同质追踪方法，一种通过原始-对偶主化-最小化算法实现的 $\ell_0$ 约束最大似然估计方法，用于估计稀疏约束下的β模型，并证明了该算法具有良好的收敛速度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Homogeneous Pursuit (HP), an ℓ0-constrained maximum likelihood estimation method for the sparse β-model, implemented via a primal-dual majorization-minimization algorithm with a guaranteed fine convergence rate.
